hotels.title: Award-Winning Grampians Homestead with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Three-Course Dinner & Wine Tasting
hotels.description: Country charm meets contemporary elegance at this boutique homestead, surrounded by the boundless beauty of the Grampians in Victoria. This sprawling 1800s estate has been restored to its former glory, yet still exudes the nostalgia of the pioneering Australian spirit. This heritage homestead sits among a picturesque five-acre garden, providing a magical setting to unwind and relax away from the stresses of everyday life. Discover the ideal launchpad to explore the region's abundance of beauty, with the trails of the Grampians National Park within easy driving distance. A commitment to farm-to-fork culinary excellence rounds out the perfect regional stay: mornings begin with a farmhouse breakfast with barista-poured coffee, while evenings are made special with indulgent three-course communal-style dinners prepared by the hotel's executive chef.
